summary: Putin ordered a three-day halt on strikes against Kyiv starting midnight September 5 to facilitate US envoy Witkoff and Kushner's visit, but Ukraine reports continued Russian drone and missile attacks across multiple oblasts. Ukraine's Office of the President claims Moscow refused Ukraine's ceasefire proposals despite the announced pause. Russian forces claim liberation of Kurtovka in DPR and struck multiple Ukrainian infrastructure targets.
key_points: Putin ordered no strikes on Kyiv for three days from midnight September 5 due to US negotiator visit, confirmed by Peskov (Source: @tass_agency/393939).
US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow for talks on Ukraine ceasefire, with a planned visit to Kyiv on September 6 (Source: @UkraineNow/83903).
Ukraine claims it proposed a truce in the sky and on the front to Russia, but Moscow refused, according to Budanov's statement via Suvsitne (Source: @UkraineNow/83901).

Russian forces struck Kamianske on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast killing 4 people, and attacked Mykolaiv's Epicentrum and a 9-story building in Borispol injuring multiple civilians (Source: @UkraineNow/83894).
Russian MoD claims liberation of Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR, with drone operators from Southern Group of Forces involved (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026).
Multiple Shahed drones and ballistic missiles struck Kyiv, Dnipro, Khmelnytskyi, Zaporizhzhia, and Chernihiv oblasts on September 5-6 (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73780).
Russian strike destroyed a cargo ship in Chornomorsk port carrying Western military equipment and hit an ammunition production facility in Borispol (Source: @tass_agency/393937).

sections.executive_summary: Putin ordered a three-day halt on strikes against Kyiv starting midnight September 5 to facilitate US envoy Witkoff and Kushner's visit, but Ukraine reports continued Russian drone and missile attacks across multiple oblasts. Ukraine's Office of the President claims Moscow refused Ukraine's ceasefire proposals despite the announced pause. Russian forces claim liberation of Kurtovka in DPR and struck multiple Ukrainian infrastructure targets including a cargo ship in Chornomorsk and ammunition facilities in Borispol.
ukraine: Ukraine's Office of the President stated that Ukraine proposed a truce in the sky and on the front to Russia, but Moscow refused, with Budanov's statement citing that 'drones are flying, you saw it yourself' (Source: @UkraineNow/83901).

ZSU stated that combat operations continue despite reports of a 'silence regime,' emphasizing that ceasefire cannot be unilateral or asymmetric, and defensive operations are being executed in full scope (Source: @UkraineNow/83900).

Four people were killed in the Russian strike on an enterprise in Kamianske, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast; two injured in Mykolaiv's Epicentrum attack; two injured in Borispol's 9-story building strike (Source: @UkraineNow/83894).
Russian strike destroyed all transport at a truck parking area in Zaporizhzhia, with a similar strike reported in Pavlograd on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (Source: @UkraineNow/83897).
Kyiv Independent reported that Witkoff 'was scared' to travel to Kiev, and alternative options for the US envoy visit are being considered (Source: @UkraineNow/83891).

Ukrainian media and military groups report that Ukrainian Armed Forces allegedly received orders to maintain ceasefire from 12:00 AM September 5 to 11:59 PM September 8, though not officially confirmed (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33016).
A Prosecutor's Office official, reportedly deputy head of cyber department Sergei Kropiva, was suspended over alleged facilitation of fraud call center network (Source: @UkraineNow/83892).
russia: Peskov confirmed Putin ordered no strikes on Kyiv for three days from midnight to facilitate American negotiator contacts, with Witkoff and Kushner visiting Moscow and planned Kiev (Source: @tass_agency/393939).

Russian MoD reported strike on cargo ship in Chornomorsk port carrying Western military equipment delivered to AFU, and struck ammunition and explosives production facility in Borispol, Kyiv Oblast (Source: @tass_agency/393937).

Russian MoD claims liberation of settlement Kurtovka near Druzhkovka in DPR, with drone operators from Southern Group of Forces participating in the operation (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026, @ukr_leaks_eng/33032).
Putin stated tens of thousands of Muscovites are fighting in the SVO zone, demonstrating courage and heroism during City Day celebrations (Source: @tass_agency/393903).
Podubny asked Putin to allow volunteers with health category 'D' to serve in regional military units (Source: @tass_agency/393926).
Russia and Pakistan are working on launching first freight rail route, reported by Russian ambassador to Pakistan Khorev (Source: @tass_agency/393933).
Pro-Russian underground reported ultra-right groups hunting Polish citizens in Ukraine, forming 'duty groups' receiving coordinates through specialized chats (Source: @tass_agency/393929).
eastern_front: Russian forces claim liberation of Kurtovka settlement located near Druzhkovka in DPR, with drone operators from Southern Group of Forces involved in the operation (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026).
Shahed drones were reported over Zaporizhzhia, with 3 Shaheds targeting Zaporizhzhia and 1 Shahed flying over the area (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73771).
A Shahed drone was reported from Donetsk Oblast heading toward Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Pavlogradsky district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73771).
Russian strike hit truck parking area in Zaporizhzhia destroying all transport, with similar strike on Pavlograd (Source: @UkraineNow/83897).
A Shahed drone was reported heading from Zaporizhzhia toward Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Pokrovskoye settlement (Source: @kpszsu/76638).
Shahed drone circled in Pavlograd area, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73762).
Threat of ballistic weapons use from southeastern direction was reported (Source: @kpszsu/76636).
northern_front: Seven Shahed drones targeted Kyiv Oblast: 3 from Chernihiv Oblast toward Vyshgorodsky district, 3 from Chernihiv toward Brovarsky district, 1 from Cherkasy toward Bila Tserkva district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73780).
Shahed drones from Chernihiv Oblast targeted Brovarsky district of Kyiv Oblast on multiple occasions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73763, @mon1tor_ua/73762).
Shahed drones from Chernihiv Oblast targeted Kyiv Oblast heading toward Zgurivka and Velyka Dymerka settlements (Source: @kpszsu/76628, @kpszsu/76629).
Three Shahed drones from Cherkasy Oblast passed near Kaniv and Korsun-Shevchenkivsky heading toward Kyiv Oblast (Source: @eRadarrua/110969).
Shahed drone from Bryansk Oblast targeted Chernihiv Oblast, Chernihiv district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73771).
Shahed drone from Poltava Oblast targeted Cherkasy Oblast, Zolotonosky district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73771).
New group of Shahed drones from Chernihiv Oblast heading toward Kyiv Oblast was detected (Source: @kpszsu/76607).
southern_front: Two Shahed drones circled north of Odesa, and 2 Shahed drones from Kherson Oblast targeted Black Sea waters (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73762).
Russian strike hit cargo ship in Chornomorsk port, Odesa Oblast, carrying Western military equipment (Source: @tass_agency/393937).
Mykolaiv's Epicentrum facility was attacked with two people injured (Source: @UkraineNow/83894).
Shahed drone from Mykolaiv Oblast targeted Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, Kryvyi Rih district (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73771).
Two Shahed drones from Kherson Oblast targeted Black Sea water area (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73762).
Russian strike on warehouse facilities reported in Buchansky and Obukhovsky districts of Kyiv Oblast (Source: @UkraineNow/83894).
Shahed drones were reported heading toward Odesa area with drones circling in multiple directions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73762).
air_war: Multiple Shahed drones launched across Ukraine targeting Kyiv, Khmelnytskyi, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Vinnytsia, Chernihiv, Poltava, Cherkasy, Zhytomyr, Sumy, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73771, @mon1tor_ua/73780).
Ballistic missiles struck Dnipro city on multiple occasions, with reports of 2, 3, and 4 ballistic missiles targeting the city (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73740, @mon1tor_ua/73741, @mon1tor_ua/73743).
Ballistic missiles struck Kamianske on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73744).
Active tactical aviation threat reported on northeastern direction, with potential use of aviation strike means for frontline oblasts (Source: @kpszsu/76626).
Shahed drones from Khmelnytskyi Oblast targeted multiple directions including Starokonstantinov, Shepetivka, and Khmelnytskyi city (Source: @kpszsu/76608, @eRadarrua/110984, @kpszsu/76625).
Shahed drones from Vinnytsia Oblast targeted multiple directions including Lipovets, Kalynivka, Sharhorod, and Kryzhopil (Source: @kpszsu/76614, @kpszsu/76620, @kpszsu/76617).
Shahed drones targeted Zhytomyr and Khmelnytskyi, with objects of Nova Poshta damaged (Source: @eRadarrua/111007).

sections.threat_assessment: The announced three-day pause on Kyiv strikes appears fragile at best, with Ukraine reporting continued Russian drone and missile strikes across multiple oblasts despite the ceasefire announcement. Russia's simultaneous military operations—including the claimed liberation of Kurtovka in DPR and strikes on Chornomorsk port and Borispol—suggest Moscow is leveraging diplomatic engagement while maintaining offensive pressure. The reported refusal by Moscow to accept Ukraine's ceasefire proposals indicates the pause may be a tactical maneuver rather than a genuine de-escalation, with the risk of resumed strikes after the three-day window.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine's ZSU has publicly stated that defensive operations continue in full scope, rejecting any unilateral ceasefire that would endanger military personnel. The US envoy mission to Moscow and Kiev represents the most significant diplomatic intervention, though reports of Witkoff's reluctance suggest potential complications. Regional infrastructure across central and eastern Ukraine remains under sustained attack, with civilian casualties reported in Kamianske, Mykolaiv, and Borispol, potentially hardening public opposition to any concessions in negotiations.
sections.intelligence_notes: The pattern of Shahed drone launches from multiple oblasts—Chernihiv, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia, Poltava, and Donetsk—indicates Russia maintains distributed launch capabilities despite the announced pause. The strike on Chornomorsk cargo ship with Western military equipment represents a significant escalation targeting foreign supply chains. The reported activation of ultra-right groups hunting Polish citizens in Ukraine and the Prosecutor General's disappearance since Friday suggest internal instability within Ukraine's governance structure that could complicate the diplomatic process.
